delete.description: Delete Route Table. Blocked for default or in-use Route Tables.

delete.description: Delete Route Table Route and remove it from the core router.

post.description:
Create a VPC Peering between two zone-less, non-overlapping VPCs.

Starts in pending status and only carries traffic once accepted.

put.description: Update VPC Peering description. CMP-only, no core call.

delete.description: Delete VPC Peering and the Route Table Routes using it as nexthop.

post.description:
Accept a pending VPC Peering, which starts carrying traffic.

Rejected, already active, or already connected the other way round: 400.
Reject a pending VPC Peering. Terminal: it cannot be accepted after.
Attach private subnets to Direct Connect.
Detach private subnets from Direct Connect.

Create a new Floating IP: allocate a public IP from the region pool.

Returned in ``creating`` status: the allocation runs asynchronously through
FloatingIPCreatedEvent, which settles the status once IaaS answers.

delete.description: Delete Floating IP: release the public IP back to the region pool.

put.description: Update Floating IP description (DB only, no core call).
